question: By what placement and in what manner must air be drawn at the root of the tongue and palate?
premises: Air is to be placed at the root of the tongue and palate.
Having made that placement, air is to be drawn.
That drawing is to be done slowly.
inference: Having placed air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should draw it slowly.
uncertainties: Purpose of drawing air not stated here
plain_english: Having placed air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.
